subject: Manufacturer / packer / importer name and address
description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer. If the manufacturer is not the packer, both names and addresses. For imported packs, the importer's name and address.
method: Named-entity extraction over the address block; the qualifying words manufactured by, packed by and imported by are detected and attributed per the Explanations to Rule 6.

subject: Generic Name
description: Common or generic name of the commodity.
method: Classified against a commodity lexicon; brand name alone is rejected as insufficient.

subject: Net Quantity
description: Net quantity in standard units of weight, measure or number.
method: Regex plus unit parser over the panel; value and unit normalised and cross-checked against Rules 12 and 13.

subject: Month and Year of Manufacture
description: Month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.
method: Date parser accepting words, numerals or both; category exemptions applied for food, cosmetics, bidi and LPG.

subject: Retail Sale Price
description: Retail sale price of the package in specified format.
method: Pattern match on the prescribed wording; value parsed and the Rule 2(m) rounding convention verified.

subject: Dimensions
description: Where dimensions of commodity exist.
method: Declared dimensions parsed where the size of the commodity is relevant.

subject: Contact details
description: Consumer care contact details if other than R6_2
method: Presence check for any further matter these Rules require on the panel.

subject: Consumer Care Details
description: Name, address, telephone, email of the person who can be or the office which can be, contacted, in case of consumer complaints.
method: Presence of contact name or office, address, telephone and e-mail; each component reported separately.

subject: Sticker over MRP
description: Declaration of MRP shall not be covered by sticker.
method: Edge and texture discontinuity detection around the MRP region; officer confirms.

subject: Numeral height by weight/volume
description: Minimum numeral height based on net quantity.
method: Glyph height in mm from calibration, tested against the 1 / 2 / 4 mm bands, doubled for blown or embossed containers.

subject: Numeral height by panel area
description: Minimum numeral height based on principal display panel area.
method: Panel area estimated from calibration, then the 1 / 2 / 4 / 6 mm bands applied.

subject: Letter height and width ratio
description: Width of letter shall not be less than one-third of its height.
method: Minimum 1 mm letter height; width measured at no less than one third of height, excluding the exempted glyphs.

subject: Panel placement and clear space
description: Clear space around quantity declaration.
method: Panel classification plus geometric measurement of the printed-matter-free margin around the quantity declaration.

subject: Legibility
description: Declarations shall be legible and prominent.
method: Capture quality and per-token OCR confidence reported as evidence; prominence remains an officer judgement.

subject: Contrast of MRP and quantity
description: Adequate contrast between text and background.
method: Local luminance contrast ratio between glyph pixels and background; ambiguous cases routed to review.

subject: Not read through liquid
description: Declarations shall not be printed so as to be read through liquid.
method: Transparency and refraction cues; flagged for the officer, never auto-failed.

subject: Language
description: Declarations must be in Hindi in Devanagari script or English.
method: Script detection across the declaration block for Devanagari and Latin.

subject: When packed qualifier
description: When packed qualifier permitted only for Third Schedule items.
method: Phrase detection cross-referenced against the Third Schedule commodity list.

subject: Correct unit class
description: Quantity expressed in terms of weight, volume, measure, etc. correctly.
method: Commodity state inferred, then mass, length, area, volume or number verified as the right basis.

subject: Misleading quantity wording
description: No ambiguous expressions around quantity.
method: Lexicon match for minimum, not less than, average, about, approximately and near-variants within the quantity region.

subject: Unit subdivision
description: Correct subdivision of units.
method: Gram below a kilogram, millilitre below a litre, centimetre below a metre.

subject: Sale above MRP
description: Sale of commodity above retail sale price.
method: Declared MRP compared against the shelf or listing price captured during inspection.

subject: Advertisement font parity
description: Advertisement parity check.
method: For listing scans, net-quantity font size compared against retail-sale-price font size.

subject: Spelling check
description: Check for basic spellings in descriptions.
method: Dictionary check with a domain lexicon; doubles as an OCR-quality signal. Advisory only, carries no penalty.
